title: Roller Skate Birthday
description: A neon roller-disco build in purple, magenta, and cyan under coloured wash lighting. Holographic plates and skate-print favour cards on the tables, a drip cake crowded with figurines and candles, and a food counter run with balloon clusters, piped treat bags, parfait cups, and chalkboard labels at each station.

alt.octopus-birthday-cake.jpg: A pastel drip birthday cake topped with candles and small figurines, on a gold stand against a purple wall
alt.neon-party-table-balloons.jpg: A children's party table under purple wash lighting with white, pink, and yellow balloon clusters and holographic plates
alt.holographic-place-setting.jpg: A holographic place setting with a printed roller skate favour card and a piped treat bag
alt.neon-balloons-on-counter.jpg: Purple and white balloon clusters above a counter set with foil favours and an Enjoy sign
alt.piped-treat-bags-and-cupcakes.jpg: Piped white treat bags tied with pink ribbon beside cupcakes and a plush monkey on a dark counter
alt.pink-octopus-plush.jpg: A large pink crocheted octopus plush on a counter beside pastel balloons and a party sign
